## R5: analytical result
Under smooth prescribed X=ln(a/a0), photon birth S(X)>=0 and opacity k(X)>=0, exact linear characteristic N'=S-kN gives the midpoint exponential update N_+=exp(-k_m h)N+h S_m phi1(-k_m h), phi1(z)=expm1(z)/z, continuous at k=0 and positive. Exact Taylor local h² defects for four independent clocks (checked with Wolfram Language):
- S_left / k_mid: -S'/2.
- S_mid / k_left: +k' N/2.
- all births at step start: -k S/2.
- both midpoint: zero.
Extends to positive mass-action neutral feedback N'=S-lambda N M, M'=-lambda N M, I'=+lambda N M using exact pair flow and Strang half-source. No claim for moving spectral thresholds or source-born full native photon transport. See `stages/R5_THEORY_KO.md`.
